guidance: Stay blameless and factual. Focus on user impact, timeline, root cause, and preventive actions. Prefer timestamps and concrete systems over narrative blame. Keep action items owned and specific.

children.title: User Impact
children.guidance: What users experienced, severity, and roughly how long it lasted.

children.title: Event
children.guidance: Title each instance with a short event label, not "Event".

children.title: Timestamp
children.guidance: When this event occurred (include timezone if known).

children.title: Action Taken
children.guidance: What the system or team did at that moment.

children.title: What Went Wrong
children.guidance: Core technical or process failure (systems and conditions, not people).

children.title: Follow-up
children.guidance: Title each instance with the follow-up action, not "Follow-up".

children.title: Intent
children.guidance: How this prevents the same failure.
